# BinNorm {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
BinNorm(μ₁, μ₂, σ₁, σ₂)
```
A binormal (two-component Gaussian mixture) distribution with equal weights: with probability 1/2 a draw comes from `Normal(μ₁, σ₁)` and with probability 1/2 from `Normal(μ₂, σ₂)`.
 

```julia-repl
dist = BinNorm(0.0, 3.0, 1.0, 2.0)
rand(dist)
```


:::
